digest.component_or_area: Mypy static type checking configuration and enforcement
propositions: Enable four approved Mypy strictness flags globally: no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, and warn_unused_ignores while explicitly deferring disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs.
Remove redundant int cast at editor.py:515 and verify all 26 unused type-ignore comments across 22 files are either genuinely stale or have their suppressions resolved.
Add a ratchet test in test_mypy_ratchet.py that asserts the four approved flags are enabled and the two deferred flags are not enabled globally.
Perform all unused-ignore remediation only in the canonical pinned, fully provisioned CI environment to ensure compatibility with pinned Mypy version and all optional dependencies.
